scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limit: Fixed-window local limit only; no all-support uniform relative error or rate asserted. Standard Hardy-Ramanujan and distinct/odd partition asymptotics are inputs.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.priority_risk: An unindexed or implicit general multivariate integer-partition theorem may imply the local result; independent priority review remains open.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scientific_integrity: Exact coefficient identity is elementary, not attributed as a novel identity. Finite checks are reproducibility checks, not proofs of an infinite limit.

title: Sharp lattice Gaussian law for the odd–even total-weight discrepancy of integer partitions
